text: The National Flood Risk Data Integration Platform (NFRDIP) is a proposed government-led initiative in the Philippines aimed at centralizing various data types, including hydrologic, meteorologic, topographic, land use, and socio-economic information. This platform is designed to enhance real-time forecasting, planning, and infrastructure design to manage flood risks across the country. It is introduced via House Bill No. 2201 and led by the Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) in collaboration with key technical agencies. The initiative seeks to improve coordination and build on existing national capacities without creating new bureaucratic structures.
